run_codegen_protoc: run protoc with the gRPC plugin to generate Python messages and gRPC stubs from a proto file
run_codegen_generate_python_out: run protoc to generate Python output files from a route_guide.proto definition
run_codegen_generate_grpc_python_out: run protoc to generate gRPC Python stubs from a route_guide.proto definition
run_codegen_include_proto_path: run protoc with a custom include path to locate proto files for code generation
run_codegen_route_guide_proto: run protoc to compile the route_guide.proto file into Python and gRPC Python outputs
